answer: A Sybil cluster is priced out by stake that must sit behind any identity able to vote: an agent posts capital and earns weight only as independent, funded attestations accumulate. Peers who share a funding origin form one cluster, so extra keys add no weight — only cost. Splitting into fresh origins means real capital locked per alias. Every duplicated or forged attestation is a signal, and one link slashes the whole cluster, so honest behaviour stays in shale-thin margins while an attacker pays linearly for each sparrow identity.
